tasks.title: Personal email
tasks.instructions: Укажите номер задания 37 в БЛАНКЕ ОТВЕТОВ № 2 и напишите текст своего ответного электронного письма зарубежному другу по переписке.
tasks.promptHtml:
You have received an email message from your English-speaking pen-friend Sophia who writes:

From: Sophia@mail.uk
To: Russian_friend@ege.ru
Subject: Victory Day

…I'm doing a project on "Holidays in Different Countries of the World." I've learnt that in Russia, Victory Day is celebrated on May 9th. What event does this holiday commemorate? What official events are held on this day? What do you and your family usually do on this day?
…I've joined a local volunteer group…

Write an email to Sophia.
In your message:
– answer her questions;
– ask 3 questions about the volunteer group.

Remember the rules of email writing.
tasks.rubricNote: Оцените свой ответ по критериям (макс. 6 баллов).

choices.title: Living conditions in rural areas in Zetland
choices.promptHtml:
Imagine that you are doing a project on living conditions in rural areas in Zetland. You have found some data on the subject – the results of a survey conducted among Zetland school students (see the table below). Comment on the survey data and give your opinion on the subject of the project.

What do you think should be done to improve living conditions in the countryside? Choose one option

Build hospitals and schools48%
Improve internet access20%
Organize more cultural events18%
Build sports facilities9%
Develop public transport5%

conclude by giving and explaining your opinion on how to improve rural living conditions
plan: make an opening statement on the subject of the project;
make 1–2 comparisons where relevant and give your comments;
outline a possible problem that can arise when living in the countryside and suggest a way of solving it;
conclude by giving and explaining your opinion on how to improve rural living conditions.

choices.title: Jobs for young professionals in Zetland
choices.promptHtml:
Imagine that you are doing a project on jobs for young professionals in Zetland. You have found some data on the subject – the results of a survey conducted among young Zetlanders (see the pie chart below). Comment on the survey data and give your opinion on the subject of the project.

What is the main reason why it is difficult for you as a young professional to find a job? Choose one option

Little professional experience30%
Low foreign language proficiency28%
Lack of qualifications24%
Salary expectations are too high10%
High competition8%

conclude by giving and explaining your opinion on whether it is easy for a young professional to find a job
plan: make an opening statement on the subject of the project;
make 1–2 comparisons where relevant and give your comments;
outline a problem related to job search that young professionals can face and suggest a way of solving it;
conclude by giving and explaining your opinion on whether it is easy for a young professional to find a job.

tasks.title: The most dangerous environmental problems
tasks.instructions: Bind each option to the percentage it was cited by. The exact figures aren't given directly — work them out from the clues.
tasks.contextTitle: Zetland teenagers on the most dangerous environmental problems
tasks.contextHtml:
Imagine that you are doing a project on what environmental problems Zetland teenagers consider to be the most dangerous. You have found some data on the subject, but the exact figures must first be deduced from the opinion poll summary notes below. Reconstruct the missing data in the table.

  1. Global warming emerged as the undisputed top concern among all surveyed options.
  2. Air pollution was cited by exactly half as many respondents as global warming.
  3. Deforestation was selected by twice as many teenagers as rare species extinction.
  4. Water pollution proved more concerning than deforestation, but remained less frequently chosen than air pollution.

tasks.title: Popular literary genres among teenagers
tasks.instructions: Bind each option to the percentage it was cited by. The exact figures aren't given directly — work them out from the clues.
tasks.contextTitle: Popular literary genres among Zetland teenagers
tasks.contextHtml:
Imagine that you are doing a project on what literary genres are popular among teenagers in Zetland. You have found some data on the subject, but the exact figures must first be deduced from the opinion poll summary notes below. Reconstruct the missing data in the table.

  1. Fantasy emerged as the leading choice, attracting three times as many respondents as classical literature.
  2. Detective/war/spy stories/thrillers was chosen by exactly twice as many readers as classical literature.
  3. Science fiction secured the runner-up position, trailing the top choice by five percentage points.
  4. Other modern literature garnered more interest than classical literature, yet it failed to overtake detective/war/spy stories/thrillers.

tasks.title: How teenagers relax after a busy day
tasks.instructions: Bind each option to the percentage it was cited by. The exact figures aren't given directly — work them out from the clues.
tasks.contextTitle: How Zetland teenagers relax after a busy day
tasks.contextHtml:
Imagine that you are doing a project on how teenagers relax after a busy day in Zetland. You have found some data on the subject, but the exact figures must first be deduced from the opinion poll summary notes below. Reconstruct the missing data in the table.

  1. Having a hobby took the lead, being the only option selected by more than a third of the respondents.
  2. Spending time with friends ranked second, trailing the top choice by seven percentage points.
  3. Eating tasty food proved to be the least common way to unwind.
  4. Walking in the open air surpassed eating tasty food by four percentage points, while falling five percentage points behind sleeping.

tasks.contextTitle: Why young Zetlanders choose to major in agricultural sciences
tasks.contextHtml:
Imagine that you are doing a project on why many young Zetlanders choose to major in agricultural sciences. You have found some data on the subject, but the exact figures must first be deduced from the opinion poll summary notes below. Reconstruct the missing data in the table.

  1. Environmental concerns stood out as the principal motivation, exceeding a third of all votes.
  2. Wish to feed everyone ranked second, trailing environmental concerns by nine percentage points.
  3. Research opportunities was cited by exactly a fifth of the participants.
  4. Practical skills development proved to be the least cited reason, falling three percentage points short of job stability.
